full_judgment: In the schedule to the plaint, there is no specific boundary to identify from which portion of the suit plot the plaintiff prayed for khas possession where the trial court criticized the boundary contain in the schedule-I of the property in the exchange deed to be vague and confusing. Plaintiff having failed to comply with the mandatory requirement of law in giving clear description or boundary to indentify the suit land, is not entitled to any decree for defect in the plaint as held in the case of Md. Sorboddi Miah vs. Md. Serajul Haque and another, reported in 12 ADC 413 and Noor Mohammad Khan and others vs. Bangladesh and others, reported in 42 DLR 435.
